label: Spatiotemporal
resolution: Three senses are kept apart and none is defined from another: occupying a region (DEF-SPATIOTEMPORAL-LOCATED, the occupant sense), standing in spatiotemporal relations (DEF-SPATIOTEMPORAL-RELATED) and being a part of the spacetime whole (DEF-PART-OF-SPACETIME). Every naturalist thesis takes its sense as the parameter P, so a statement never passes from one sense to another without an explicit bridge statement. Spatiotemporality is a property separate from concreteness (DISAMB-CONCRETE-ABSTRACT-CRITERIA): the spatiotemporal concreteness criterion is a rival sense of concrete, not this property, and SPATIOTEMPORAL-INDEPENDENT-OF-CONCRETE certifies that each sense is independent of the adopted esse sense. Occupation is dimensive: God's presence everywhere by power, presence and essence (ST I q.8 a.3) and an angel's definitive presence by applying its power (q.52 a.1) are not occupation, so a Thomist God present everywhere is not thereby Located. That is the analyst's reading choice, recorded here, not a source claim.
